decision_rationale: CellWhisperer is presented as a new multimodal model that jointly embeds transcriptomes and natural language for scRNA-seq exploration. The title, abstract, and full-text section all support a central text-bio bridge rather than a wrapper.
evidence_snippet: “bridges the gap between transcriptomics data and natural language”; “cell retrieval based on free-text queries”; “compress the structured metadata ... into concise natural language summaries”,
